przepis.opis_efektu: Multiple chat bubbles appear in sequence, each from a different named bot. Each bot has: a small colored avatar circle (unique color per bot), a bold name label above their bubble, and message text. Bots @mention each other in the text. Messages appear bottom-to-top, each one streaming in as a typewriter effect. 2–3 bots, 1–2 messages each. The interface sits in the lower 50% of frame, dark background, slightly transparent. Each bot has a distinct accent color for their name and avatar.
